module Control.IfElseReturn

function classify(amount: Integer) returns Integer
    ensures (amount > 0 and result = 1) or (amount <= 0 and result = 0)
is
    if amount > 0 then
        return 1
    else
        return 0
    end if
end classify

procedure main()
is
    check classify(1) = 1
end main

end Control.IfElseReturn
